original: aniyatakālatvād vaidikānāṃ śubhāśubhaphalānāṃ karmaṇām evam ucyate | nādharmaś caritaḥ anuṣṭhitaḥ sadyaḥ phalati phalaṃ dadāti | vede hi kevalaṃ karmaṇāṃ vihitapratiṣiddhānāṃ sukhaduḥkhapalatvaṃ śrutam | kālaviśeṣas tu nāvagamitaḥ | vākyavyāpāro hi kartavyatāvagamaparatve 'pi karmaphalasaṃbandhabodhamātre paryavasyati, na kālaviśeṣam ākṣipati phalavatāṃ karmaṇām | nityānāṃ tu na phalataḥ kartavyatā | pratiṣiddhaparihāre[232] 'pi naiva narakādiduḥkhanivṛttikāmasyādhikāraḥ, kiṃ tu śāstrapratiṣedhasāmarthyāt | sa tu pratiṣedho duḥkhaphalatvaṃ pratiṣiddhānuṣṭhānasya bodhayati | nipunata etad ucyamānam atigranthavistaram ākṣipatīty uparamyate |
analyzed: aniyata kāla tvāt vaidikānām śubha aśubha phalānām karmaṇām evam ucyate na adharmaḥ caritaḥ anuṣṭhitaḥ sadyas phalati phalam dadāti vede hi kevalam karmaṇām vihita pratiṣiddhānām sukha duḥkha pala tvam śrutam kāla viśeṣaḥ tu na avagamitaḥ vākya vyāpāraḥ hi kartavyatā avagama paratve pi karma phala saṃbandha bodha mātre paryavasyati na kāla viśeṣam ākṣipati phalavatām karmaṇām nityānām tu na phalataḥ kartavyatā pratiṣiddha parihāre pi na eva

original: gaur iva | sādharmyavaidharmābhyām ayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā gauḥ pṛthivī vyuptabījā na tadaivānekasasyaśālinī bhavati, kiṃ tarhi, paripākam apekṣate, tādṛśaṃ vaidikaṃ karmeti sādharmyam | vaidharmyeṇāpi, yathā gauḥ paśur vāhadohābhyāṃ sadyaḥ phalati, naivaṃ dharmādharmau | adharmagrahaṇaṃ dharmasyāpi phaladānaṃ prati kālāniyamapradarśanārtham | āvartyamānaḥ kālenopacīyamānaḥ | kartuḥ pratiṣiddhānuṣṭhātuḥ mūlāni kṛntati chinatti | mūlakartanena sarveṇa sarvavināśa upalakṣyate | yathā mūlacchedād vṛkṣādisthāvarāṇām apunarbhavas tadvad adharmakāriṇām || 4.172 ||
analyzed: gauḥ iva sādharmya vaidharmābhyām ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā gauḥ pṛthivī vyupta bījā na tadā eva aneka sasya śālinī bhavati kim tarhi paripākam apekṣate tādṛśam vaidikam karma iti sādharmyam vaidharmyeṇa api yathā gauḥ paśuḥ vāha dohābhyām sadyas phalati na evam dharma adharmau adharma grahaṇam dharmasya api phala dānam prati kāla aniyama pradarśana artham āvartyamānaḥ kālena upacīyamānaḥ kartuḥ pratiṣiddha anuṣṭhātuḥ mūlāni kṛntati chinat

original: satyam | putre pīḍyamāne pīḍitasya pitur adhikataraṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavati | ataḥ kartur eva duḥkham | putrasyāpi svakṛtāt paurvadehikāt karmaṇas tatphalam ity aviruddham | evaṃ naptṛṣv api draṣṭavyam | naptāraḥ pautrāḥ | kṛto 'dharma iti saṃhitāyās tulyatvād dharmādharmau dvāv apy upāttau || 4.173 ||
analyzed: satyam putre pīḍyamāne pīḍitasya pituḥ adhikataram duḥkham bhavati atas kartuḥ eva duḥkham putrasya api sva kṛtāt paurvadehikāt karmaṇaḥ tad phalam iti aviruddham evam naptṛṣu api draṣṭavyam naptāraḥ pautrāḥ kṛtaḥ dharmaḥ iti saṃhitāyāḥ tulya tvāt dharma adharmau dvau api upāttau

original: adharmeṇa prabhudrohādinā edhate vṛddhiṃ labhate | tāvat tasminn eva kāle | tato dhanaṃ grāmaṃ vā prāpya, tato bhadrāṇi bahubhṛtyagavāśvādi saṃpattilakṣaṇāni paśyaty anubhavati | tataḥ sapatnān arīn daridrāñ jayati paribhavati | tarhi dharme sthitān kutaścana kusṛtihīnā labhante | atas teṣāṃ dāridryaśabda aiśvarye paribhavaḥ | samūlaṃ ca kiyantaṃ kālam evaṃ bhūtvā saputrajñātidhanabāndhavā ucchidyante | tasmād dharmo na hātavyaḥ || 4.174 ||
analyzed: adharmeṇa prabhu droha ādinā edhate vṛddhim labhate tāvat tasmin eva kāle tatas dhanam grāmam vā prāpya tatas bhadrāṇi bahu bhṛtya gavāśva ādi saṃpatti lakṣaṇāni paśyati anubhavati tatas sapatnān arīn daridrān jayati paribhavati tarhi dharme sthitān kutaścana kusṛti hīnāḥ labhante atas teṣām dāridrya śabdaḥ aiśvarye paribhavaḥ samūlam ca kiyantam kālam evam bhūtvā sa putra jñāti dhana bāndhavāḥ ucchidyante tasmāt dharmaḥ na hātavyaḥ

original: satyaṃ yathādṛṣṭārthavāditā | dharmaḥ śrutiviṣayau vidhipratiṣedhau | satyasya tādrūpye 'pi bedena nirdeśo 'tiśayārthaḥ | anṛtaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ svabhāvabhūtam | ato yatnena punaḥ punaḥ pratiṣidhyate | āryavṛttaṃ sadācāraḥ | āryāḥ śiṣṭās teṣāṃ vṛttam ācaritam | tatra āramet | ratiḥ paritoṣaḥ | eteṣv artheṣu paritoṣo 'nena vidhīyate | anyān apy evam ācārān dṛṣṭvā manaḥprasādaṃ kuryāt | śiṣyāś caiva[233] bhāryāputradāsacchātrā dharmeṇānuśāsanīyāḥ | "pṛṣṭhatas tu śarīrasya" (MDh 8.300) ityādidharmāḥ | vāgbāhūdarasaṃyataḥ | saty asati ca prayojane abahubhāṣitā vāksaṃsamaḥ | bāhvoḥ saṃyamo bāhubalāśrayaṇena kasyacid api apīḍanam[234] | udarasya saṃyamo 'naudarikatā abahubhojitvam | audarikatā bahubhojitvaṃ bhojyaviśeṣe gardhayā paragṛhe bāhulyena bhojanam |
analyzed: satyam yathā dṛṣṭa artha vādi tā dharmaḥ śruti viṣayau vidhi pratiṣedhau satyasya tādrūpye bedena anṛtam puruṣāṇām svabhāva bhūtam atas yatnena punar punar pratiṣidhyate ārya vṛttam sat ācāraḥ āryāḥ śiṣṭāḥ teṣām vṛttam ācaritam tatra āramet ratiḥ paritoṣaḥ eteṣu artheṣu paritoṣaḥ nena vidhīyate anyān api evam ācārān dṛṣṭvā manaḥ prasādam kuryāt śiṣyāḥ ca eva bhāryā putra dāsa chātrāḥ anurāga anurāga anurāga

analyzed: dharmam ca api asukha udarkam loka saṃkruṣṭam eva ca

original: uktas trivargaḥ puruṣārthaḥ | kaścit tulyatāṃ manyamānaḥ — arthakāmaparihāreṇa yathā dharmaḥ sevyate tadvirodhī jyotiṣṭomādiḥ | sa hy arthavirodhī dakṣiṇādidānena, kāmavirodhī dīkṣitasya brahmacaryavidhānāt | evam arthakāmāv api dharmaparihāreṇa na seveta | tatra "na hiṃsyād bhūtāni" iti yatra kāmo hiṃsāyā vairānubandhād yaḥ kaścid vaktum iṣyate tatra sa viṣayapratiṣedhāya, yatra tu kasyacid dhiṃsayārthakāmāv iṣyete tatra nāsti hiṃsādoṣaḥ — iti parvartate, tadbhrāntinivṛttyartham idam ucyate |
analyzed: uktaḥ trivargaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ kaścid tulya tām manyamānaḥ artha kāma parihāreṇa yathā dharmaḥ sevyate tad virodhī jyotiṣṭoma ādiḥ sa hi artha virodhī dakṣiṇā ādi dānena kāma virodhī dīkṣitasya brahmacarya vidhānāt evam artha kāmau api dharma parihāreṇa na seveta tatra na hiṃsyāt bhūtāni iti yatra kāmaḥ hiṃsāyāḥ vaira anubandhāt yaḥ kaścid vaktum iṣyate tatra sa viṣaya pratiṣedhāya yatra tu kasyacid hiṃsayā artha kāmau iṣyete tatra

original: parityajet pariharet tādṛśārthakāmau yatra dharmavirodhaḥ | evaṃ sarvato dharmasya balīyastvam uktvā kasmiṃścid viṣaye tasyāpi parihartavyatām āha: dharmaṃ cāpy asukhodarkam | udarkaḥ uttarakālaḥ, so 'sukho yasya — yathā sarvasvadānaṃ vā dadāti "dhārmiko 'yaṃ[235] mahāpuṇyaḥ" iti, yathā nadītīreṣv ekānteṣv api prākṛtajanā bahavaḥ paśyanti tatra snānam | bhavatīty arthasnānaṃ dharmārjanasamakṣāpekṣā[236] tu sādhuvādāya | yathā ca tīrthakākebhyo dānam | bhavati dānaṃ dharmaḥ, dātṛtvaprasiddhyutpādanārthatvāt — tebhyo bhidyate[237] | atha vā yad garhyatayā lokaḥ saṃkrośati — yathā gor avadhyasya vadhaḥ, māṃsasya bhakṣaṇaṃ ca — tad vigarhitataraṃ paśvantarebhyo loke | dṛṣṭamūlaś cāyam ahisparśavat pratiṣedhaḥ | vihito 'yam artha ity avaidyatayā prākṛtajanā ajānānā adhārmikatvaṃ yaṣṭuḥ prakhyāpayeyus teṣāṃ ca bahutvataḥ prasiddhyā śiṣṭā apy evaṃ prasiddhamūlam[238] anavagacchantaḥ parivarjayeyuḥ | tad uktam "dhārmike sati rājani" (MDh 11.10) iti |
analyzed: parityajet pariharet tādṛśa artha kāmau yatra dharma virodhaḥ evam sarvatas dharmasya balīyaḥ tvam uktvā kasmiṃścid viṣaye tasya api parihartavya tām āha dharmam ca api asukha udarkam udarkaḥ uttara kālaḥ saḥ sukhaḥ yasya yathā sarva sva dānam vā dadāti dhārmikaḥ yam mahā puṇyaḥ iti yathā nadī tīreṣu ekānteṣu api prākṛta janāḥ bahavaḥ paśyanti tatra snānam bhavati iti artha snānam dharma arjana samakṣa apekṣā tu sādhuvādāya yathā ca tīrthak

original: etad uktaṃ pūrvair vyākhyātam ity anugatam | na hi pratyakṣaśrutivihitasya smṛtyā bādho nyāyyaḥ | idaṃ tu yuktataram udāharaṇam | niyogadharmaḥ smṛtyā vihito lokasaṃkruṣṭatvān na kriyate | tathā yaḥ kaścid anāthataruṇīṃ striyaṃ kāruṇyād bibharti, tatra yadi lokasaṃkroṣa āśaṅkyate — strītvenaivāsmā eṣā rocate — sa lokasaṃkruṣṭadharmaḥ || 4.176 ||
analyzed: etat uktam pūrvaiḥ vyākhyātam iti anugatam na hi pratyakṣa śruti vihitasya smṛtyā bādhaḥ nyāyyaḥ idam tu yuktataram udāharaṇam niyoga dharmaḥ smṛtyā vihitaḥ loka saṃkruṣṭa tvāt na kriyate tathā yaḥ kaścid anātha taruṇīm striyam kāruṇyāt bibharti tatra yadi loka saṃkroṣaḥ āśaṅkyate strī tvena eva asmai eṣā rocate sa loka saṃkruṣṭa dharmaḥ
